in_marathi.name: Asoke
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ascetic, Forsaking Worldly Desires
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asoke हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Asoke is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘asukah’, which means forsaking worldly desires or an ascetic. This name is often given to children who are believed to embody the spirit of renunciation and self-discipline.
